_nota: Inglés de human_datasets_read.json (2026-11-15): castellano exacto → inglés, que `i18n.localized` aplica al servir (evidence/human_datasets.py); el original no se toca. Se traduce lo que redacta EMMA: dónde está cada frase (`where`), qué mide cada variable o área (`what`), los motivos (`why`), lo buscado (`searched`), el acceso, el uso en EMMA (`emma_use.text`), el papel y la aptitud (`level_why`, `fitness_why`), las salvedades (`caveat`, `open_population_note`), `not_found` y los nombres de conjunto que llevan una descripción en castellano. NO se traducen, por ser citas literales: `quote` (frase de la fuente, en su idioma), `kb_row` (fila de la base de conocimiento), `rule.text`, `task.text`, `fitness_rule.text`, `milestones.text`, `analog_pattern.text` y los puntos de `controls_rule`, `milestones` y `analog_pattern` (documentos del equipo), ni lo que va entre «» dentro de un texto. Tampoco identificadores, días de toma, etapas, estudios de CIPHER ni rutas de fichero. Una entrada con el mismo texto a los dos lados es un nombre propio o un rótulo de la fuente que ya está en inglés. Traducción automática, sin revisar por una persona; lo vigila tests/test_inventories_en.py.

strings.«1. Capabilities and services», «Data Re: «1. Capabilities and services», «Data Repositories» (text extracted from the PDF; the stray spaces of the extraction —double ones and one before the full stop—, normalised)
strings.la página de CIPHER y el artículo de 202: the CIPHER page and the 2023 article: neither says how the data are accessed. The HRP data management plan (NTRS, 2026-10-31) says that the HRP archives in the NLSP the in-flight human subject data that it considers unique and of high value, without naming CIPHER: the closest thing, and not enough to say that CIPHER's are there
strings.De sus catorce estudios, EMMA cita uno,: Of its fourteen studies, EMMA cites one, Spaceflight Standard Measures, in the cost of measuring: how blood and urine are collected in flight.
strings.Una suite de catorce estudios del HRP so: A suite of fourteen HRP studies on astronauts before, during and after the mission: historical evidence once it is published, not a signal that EMMA receives.
strings.Sin datos accesibles leídos, solo contex: With no accessible data read, it only gives context: EMMA cites one of its studies, Spaceflight Standard Measures, for the cost of measuring.
strings.Días L- y R+ de las tomas de CIPHER como: L- and R+ days of the CIPHER samples as a suite: searched for on the programme page, in «About CIPHER» and in the 2023 article; none gives them. Two NTRS posters (2026-10-31) give the schedule of their own study (Space Physiology and Vestibular Health), not that of the fourteen.
strings.Calendario completo de tomas del Twins S: Full sampling schedule of the Twins Study: the Science article names days in specific results (L-162; FD76, FD259, FD334, FD340; R+0, R+4, R+12, R+36, R+104, R+190; read on 2026-10-31) and refers the schedule to its figure 1A and to table S1. The supplementary material (11 MB) could not be downloaded: PMC returns an interstitial page and Europe PMC answers that the article is not open access.
strings.Lecturas en bruto de secuenciación de OS: Raw sequencing reads of OSD-569: they are not among the 11 files deposited in OSDR (blood count, processed tables, MultiQC reports and metadata, all with «restricted: false», read on 2026-10-31); the article on the mission places its data in controlled-access repositories.
strings.Una API pública de constantes vitales de: A public API of astronaut vital signs: it does not exist. LSAH is restricted access (docs/contexto/repositorios-humanos.md).
strings.Dónde quedan los datos de AGBRESA: las m: Where the AGBRESA data end up: the international standard measures are in the LSDA and are requested there (Clément et al., Acta Astronautica 2022, read on 2026-10-31 in NTRS); the protocol article says that the rest is provided by their authors; the results article on physical capacity (Kramer et al. 2021, read in full on 2026-10-26) has no data availability statement.
strings.Controles de OSD-195, OSD-198, OSD-353 y: Controls of OSD-195, OSD-198, OSD-353 and OSD-370: their OSDR records name none; the articles of OSD-198 and OSD-353 (PMC, 2026-10-31) do not either; those of OSD-195 and OSD-370 are not in PMC and were not read.
strings.Días de las tomas de las métricas de ast: Days of the samples of the astronaut metrics of OSD-343: the record only dates the RR-9 mice (L+35d, the day after the splashdown; read on 2026-10-31); for the 59 astronauts, nothing.
strings.Reposos en cama con datos abiertos fuera: Bed rests with open data outside OSDR: a web search (2026-10-23) gave none on PhysioNet or on OpenNeuro. In OSDR, the search «bed rest» (2026-10-23) gives eight studies, seven human and one of mice; the seven human ones are on the map (OSD-51 read on 2026-10-23; OSD-195, OSD-198, OSD-353, OSD-370, OSD-942 and OSD-946, on 2026-10-26).
strings.Controles en la ficha de OSD-569: su des: Controls in the OSD-569 record: its description and its factors in OSDR name none; the map gives that of the article on the Inspiration4 mission, that of its four crew members (each one, their own control).
strings.Los nombres de las diez áreas del Twins: The names of the ten areas of the Twins Study in the Science article: it says «10 generalized biomedical modalities» without naming them, and its abstract lists eleven types of data; the ten are the investigations on NASA's page. The article was read in full on 2026-10-26 and does not name them anywhere else.
